name: LM Studio
license: Free app (closed source), runs open models
summary: The easiest free AI for your computer. One app: pick an AI, download it, and chat. No typing commands.
gains: No typing commands: everything is buttons
It tells you which AIs fit your computer
Private: your chats stay on your computer
Can also run as a local "AI server" for apps you build
tradeoffs: The app itself is free but not open source (the AIs inside are)
Not as smart as the newest paid AIs, especially on smaller computers
setupSteps: Go to lmstudio.ai and click the download button for your computer (Mac, Windows or Linux)
Open the file you downloaded and install it like any other app
Open LM Studio. Click the magnifying glass (Discover) on the left
Search for the AI our Free AI page suggests (for example "Qwen3 8B") and click Download
When it finishes, click Chat on the left, pick the AI at the top, and start typing
Tip: LM Studio warns you if an AI is too big for your computer, so pick one it says will fit
commercialNote: Closed-source app. Check LM Studio's terms for workplace use; the models you run have their own licenses (see the Local AI page).
